instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problems.

atoms.a: At the zoo there are three kinds of cat. Lions, tigers, and panthers. Lions make up 40% of the cats. There are 12 lions. Work out how many cats there are in total.
In another cage, there are two kinds of apes. There are 5 gorillas, and that makes up 20% of the apes. How many apes are there in the cage in total?
On average, the zoo receives 2,862 visitors a day below the age of 20, which makes up 53% of the visitors. Work out how many daily visitors the zoo receives in total.
atoms.b: There are a total of ((++5,400 5,375 5,389)) daily visitors.

atoms.a: Some people visit the zoo café afterwards. 320 of them buy a drink which makes up 80% of the people who visit. How many people visit the zoo café in total?
atoms.b: A total of ((++400 395 410)) people visit the zoo café.
